candidate.text: When using Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands and upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSets` are used before upgrading.

evidence.excerpt: * When using Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands and upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is enabled and `StrimziPodSets` are used before upgrading.
